scope: Proposition 7.16 (Finite centers in the Hilbert sum) of the manuscript “Midpoint convexity from bounded tree potentials and path costs” (preprints/Midpoint-convexity-from-bounded-tree-potentials-and-path-costs-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 965c8f078bcaef03), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let x ∈ Xq be a unit vector with finite coordinate support. For each n with xn ̸= 0, choose a finite nonempty ancestor-closed An ⊂ Tn containing its support, and set Yx = {y ∈ Xq : PAn yn = 0 whenever xn ̸= 0}. Then Yx is a closed finite-codimensional subspace. If 0 < e ≤ 1/8, y ∈ Yx, and ∥x + y∥q, ∥x − y∥q ≤ 1 + e, then ∥y∥2 q ≤ 519 2 e1/3 , ∥y∥q ≤ 17e1/6 . (72)
